title: Strategy (MSTR) Pauses Bitcoin Buying and Spends $205 Million on Preferred Stock
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Strategy (MSTR) Pauses Bitcoin Buying and Spends $205 Million on Preferred Stock Strategy skipped bitcoin buys for the week of October 19–25 and spent $204.9 million buying back its STRC preferred stock. This post Strategy (MSTR) Pauses Bitcoin Buying and Spends $205 Million on Preferred Stock first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
